Name: Shaven and Sweatered Shane
Author: aisuroma
Description:
Shane portrait and sprite mod with sweater, polo shirt, pants, and a clean shaven face (with added dimples).
[img]http://i.imgur.com/0BJSbLh.png[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/DIX5Eac.png[/img]
I was looking for a portrait to replace the one I had for Shane, but I couldn't find many I liked, so I made my own. I especially want to make an effort to change all the collared shirts in the game from those floppy seagulls to something more substantial.

I've included an optional png to add to your cursors.xnb, if desired. The sprite is used in the four and six heart events, but I didn't really want to risk messing with that file and having to deal with transparency issues. 

This is my first mod, so if there are any issues, please let me know. I have tested it in-game and it works. I may update this in the future to change some things that I'm not currently happy with.
Please do not reupload.
